gallery.filename: USS Midway (CV-41) heavily rolling during sea trials in 1986.jpg
gallery.title: File:USS Midway (CV-41) heavily rolling during sea trials in 1986.jpg
gallery.credit: U.S. Navy photo [1] from the USS Midway (CV-41) 1987-1989 cruise book available at Navysite.de
gallery.source: USS Midway (CV-41) heavily rolling during sea trials in 1986
gallery.description: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Midway (CV-41) rolling in moderate seas during sea trials, in late 1986. During her 1986 refit (named "Extended Incremental Selected Repair Availability"), blisters had been added that seriously affected the ship's stability. She took water over the flight deck during excessive rolls in moderate seas, thereby hampering flight operations. Before another $138 million refit was approved to rectify the stability problems, it was even proposed to decommission Midway. Nevertheless, she had earned herself the nickname "Rock'n Roll carrier".

gallery.filename: Subic Bay naval base in 1982.JPEG
gallery.title: File:Subic Bay naval base in 1982.JPEG
gallery.description: The U.S. Navy aircraft carrier USS Midway (CV-41) approaching Naval Facility Subic Bay, Philippines. Midway, with assigned Carrier Air Wing 5 (CVW-5), was deployed to the Western Pacific from 14 September to 11 December 1982.  In the floating dry dock in the foreground is the Spruance-class destroyer USS David R. Ray (DD-971). Moored side-by-side at the pier are the Knox-class frigates USS Kirk (FF-1087) and USS Francis Hammond (FF-1067). The guided missile cruiser USS Sterett (CG-31) is visible in the background.

gallery.filename: US 6th Fleet warships at Istanbul in March 1950.jpg
gallery.title: File:US 6th Fleet warships at Istanbul in March 1950.jpg
gallery.description:
Warships of the U.S. Navy's Sixth Fleet anchored off the city of Istanbul, Turkey, during a good will visit, 2 March 1950. Note the U.S. Navy personnel on the landing in left center, with United States and Turkish flags flying nearby. Ships present are (from left to right): the destroyer USS Glennon (DD-840); USS Charles R. Ware (DD-865); the heavy cruiser USS Newport News (CA-148); USS Everett F. Larson (DDR-830); and the aircraft carrier USS Midway (CVB-41). Midway, with assigned Carrier Air Group 4 (CVG-4), was deployed to the Mediterranean Sea from 6 January to 23 May 1950.

The Dolmabahçe Mosque is visible in the foreground.

gallery.filename: US Navy Battle Force Zulu 1991 - DN-ST-91-07575.jpg
gallery.title: File:US Navy Battle Force Zulu 1991 - DN-ST-91-07575.jpg
gallery.description: Six ships of Battle Force Zulu (Task Force 154) steam in formation after the cease-fire that ended Operation Desert Storm.  At left, from top, are the guided missile cruiser USS Leyte Gulf (CG-55), the aircraft carriers USS Midway (CV-41) and USS Ranger (CV-61) and the guided missile cruiser USS Normandy (CG-60).  At right are the nuclear-powered aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), top, and the aircraft carrier USS America (CV-66) .
